label: miso18 seam export cap
definition: MISO seam EXPORT deliverability cap on top of miso16 (--miso-seam-export-limit): the symmetric mirror of miso12's measured import cap. measured_seam_import_envelope(direction='export') caps each seam's export-sink lower bound at the p90 EIA-930 BA-to-BA net-EXPORT envelope (PJM clips to ~0 export, South/SPP keep measured headroom). Fixes the keeper's 2025 net-export sign flip (model +17.97 -> -4.29 TWh, actual -18.96 import) and brings 2025 energy-balance into tolerance (+23.41 -> +1.17). Total net-interchange |error| 52.0 -> 23.5 TWh and total |energy-balance| 36.8 -> 20.5 TWh across 2023-25, both ~halved, no error-shuffling. No magic number / no curve fit -- a measured transfer-capability ceiling, same admissibility class as the import cap (claude.md #1/#11/#12). NOT-YET: exposes (does not cause) the remaining gas/import under-run as the next lever (2023/24 negative EB = 2024 gas -24 TWh vs EIA-923). KEEPER on faithfulness, supersedes miso16-st-gas-intermediate.
